messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — deploying runtime v2.3.1 to prod in ~20m (10:30 UTC). We'll use feature flag orchestration.ff_cutover and a 3-step ramp: 1) 5% traffic for 5m canary, 2) 25% for 10m soak, 3) 100% switch. See runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ff-cutover

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @maria for 10:30 UTC. Staging pass ok. Deployment ID: deploy-2026-06-01-177

oliver: +1. What's rollback criteria? CPU p95 > 350ms or error rate delta > 0.5% ?

sanjay: Let's lock version pinning on the router — pin model variant v2.3.1->v2.3.1-forced during canary. I'll run a quick canary drain hook.

rebecca: Added a short checklist in the thread: release notes pushed to docs, infra owners notified, post-deploy smoke tests ready. Link: https://docs.redwood.dev/releases/v2.3.1

maria: Rollback thresholds: - latency p95 +20% over baseline OR - request error rate +0.75% sustained for 3m. If hit, immediate unpin + fast-drain. Ops, confirm.

ops-bot: Acknowledged. Patch window 10:30–11:30 UTC. Pager duty rotation: oncall-1.

sanjay: Command I'll use for toggles:
```
redwood ff set orchestration.ff_cutover --cohorts "canary:5,soak:25,full:100" --strategy gradual --timeout 600
redwood ff status orchestration.ff_cutover
```

oliver: Can we add a shadow traffic check before enabling full? quick /metrics query: `/metrics query latency{service=\"runtime\",env=\"prod\"} last5m` — I'll watch.

maria: Agreed. Also enabling KV cache warmup in canary to avoid cold spike.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: deploy-2026-06-01-177 — canary roll initiated (5%). Monitoring: https://observability.redwood.internal/d/FF/ff-cutover

rebecca: Smoke tests green at 2m. :white_check_mark:

oliver: At 6m canary: p95 +3%, errors +0.05%. All good to move to 25%.

maria: Kicking 25% now.

deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: orchestration.ff_cutover -> 25% (cohort soak). Next check at +10m.

sanjay: Noting pin in router: `router.pin --service runtime --version v2.3.1 --until 11:15Z`

maria: If we see sustained regressions we rollback. Otherwise proceed to full after soak.

rebecca: Release notes snippet live. I'll file user-visible changelog later.

oliver: All green at end of soak. Proceed to 100% in 2m.

maria: Proceeding to full now. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: orchestration.ff_cutover -> 100% (full). Deploy complete.

rebecca: Post-deploy quick check: latency within thresholds, error rate stable. :tada:

ops-bot: Closing change window. If any late regressions, reopen thread and escalate.

maria: Great job team — logging postmortem notes and cost impact for Optimize team.
